narrative.overview: SignalRoom is a calm technical review surface shaped by architecture decision records, incident handovers, and audit workpapers. Provenance, uncertainty, proposal, critique, and human decision occupy stable ruled regions instead of floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Stable information columns with one-pixel rules.
Cobalt reserved for the current decision or selection.
Visible evidence provenance, confidence, and uncertainty.
Compact sans typography with mono only for identifiers and measurements.
Functional motion limited to state change and focused overlays.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Accent color always communicates state; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Mono means evidence or measurement, never generic technical atmosphere.

rules.name: The Flat Dossier Rule
rules.body: Persistent work surfaces use either a boundary or a tonal change, never decorative shadow.

dos: Do make the current human decision visible without scrolling on desktop.
Do keep source, timestamp, confidence, and evaluation details close to the claim they qualify.
Do reserve cobalt for action and current state, green for verified state, and amber/red for risk.
Do keep interactive copy at 12px or larger and operational prose at 13px or larger.
Do preserve the same control vocabulary across intake, follow-up, approval, and export.
donts: Don't introduce marketing heroes, editorial kickers, glass effects, gradients, or decorative status chips into product surfaces.
Don't place cards inside cards; use rules, spacing, and stable regions to express hierarchy.
Don't hide unknowns or turn synthetic evaluation data into customer proof.
Don't use color without a state meaning or mono type without evidence meaning.
